    if retained_simulation_scope and not excerpt_scope_goal:

def event(kind, **data):
    return f"event: {kind}\ndata: {json.dumps(dict(type=kind, **data), ensure_ascii=False)}\n\n"


def tool_block(index, arguments):
    return (event("content_block_start", index=index,
                  content_block=dict(type="tool_use", id=f"toolu_replay_{index}", name="fixture_write", input={}))
            + event("content_block_delta", index=index, delta=dict(type="input_json_delta", partial_json=arguments))
            + event("content_block_stop", index=index))

    start = event("message_start", message=dict(id="msg_replay", type="message", role="assistant",
        model="deepseek-flash", content=[], usage=dict(input_tokens=15, output_tokens=0)))

                child = subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=run_dir, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr,
                    creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
                try:
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + 45
                    while time.monotonic() < deadline and child.poll() is None:
                        if result_file.is_file():
                            return dict(result=json.loads(result_file.read_bytes()), requests=requests)
                        time.sleep(.1)
                    raise RuntimeError(f"DSH did not finish the replay; see {run_dir}")
                finally:
                    if child.poll() is None:
                        child.terminate()
                        child.wait(timeout=10)
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            thread.join(timeout=5)


def verify(replay, improved):
    rows = replay["result"].get("cases")
    assert rows is not None, replay["result"]
    expected = {name: (shapes if improved else shapes[:1]) for name, shapes in SCRIPTED.items()}
    request_log = replay["requests"]
    summaries = {}
    for name, shapes in expected.items():
        result = rows[name]
        requests = [request for request in request_log if request["label"] == name]
        assert tuple(row["shape"] for row in requests) == shapes, (name, requests)
        assert all(row["session"] == result["session"] for row in requests), (name, requests)
        attempts = [row for row in result["events"] if row["type"] == "assistant/attempt"]
        tools = [row for row in result["events"] if row["type"] == "tool/call"]
        committed = [row for row in result["events"] if row["type"] == "assistant/message"]
        end = next(row for row in result["events"] if row["type"] == "turn/end")
        recovered = improved and name in {"recover-root", "recover-child"}
        assert end["reason"]["kind"] == ("completed" if recovered else "error"), (name, end)
        if not recovered and name != "different-error":
            assert end["reason"]["error"] == dict(message=ERROR, code="MALFORMED_RESPONSE"), (name, end)
        assert all(row["failure"] == dict(message=ERROR, code="MALFORMED_RESPONSE") for row in attempts) or name == "different-error", name
        assert len(attempts) == shapes.count("bad") + shapes.count("different"), (name, attempts)
        assert result["writes"] == ["committed"] * shapes.count("valid"), (name, result["writes"])
        assert len(tools) == shapes.count("valid"), (name, tools)
        for row in tools:
            previous = next(index for index, item in enumerate(result["events"]) if item is row)
            assert any(item["type"] == "assistant/message" and item["turn"] == row["turn"] and item["step"] == row["step"]
                       for item in result["events"][:previous]), (name, row)
        if recovered:
            assert len(committed) == 2 and (attempts[0]["turn"], attempts[0]["step"]) == (committed[0]["turn"], committed[0]["step"])
        # The immediate retry receives new context; later steps only see its history.
        expected_hints = {"recover-root": [False, True, False], "recover-child": [False, True, False],
            "exhausted": [False, True], "turn-budget": [False, True, False, True, False]}
        assert [row["retryHint"] for row in requests] == (expected_hints.get(name, [False]) if improved else [False]), (name, requests)
        summaries[name] = dict(requests=requests, attempts=attempts, tools=tools, writes=result["writes"], end=end)
    return summaries


def prior_failure():
    path = WORKSPACE / "outputs/building-loop-efficiency-audit/20261110T054627Z/events.jsonl"
    events = list(map(json.loads, path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
    bad = []
    for event_row in events:
        if event_row["type"] != "assistant/attempt":
            continue
        data = event_row["data"]
        finish = next(row["chunk"] for row in data["stream"] if row.get("chunk", {}).get("type") == "finish")
        if finish["reason"].get("failure") != dict(message=ERROR, code="MALFORMED_RESPONSE"):
            continue
        assert not any(row["type"] == "tool/call" and row["sid"] == event_row["sid"] and
                       (row["data"].get("turn"), row["data"].get("step")) == (data["turn"], data["step"]) for row in events)
        bad.append(dict(turn=data["turn"], step=data["step"], providerFailure=finish["reason"]["failure"], toolCalls=0))
    assert len(bad) == 4
    return dict(run="20261110T054627Z", eventsSha256=sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), discarded=bad)


def main():
    exe = Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "Programs/DSH NEXT/DSH NEXT.exe"

    after = run(exe, directory / "current", current)
    result = dict(passed=True, runtimeSha256=sha256(current).hexdigest(), baselineSha256=sha256(baseline).hexdigest(),
        simulatedProvider="DeepSeek Messages SSE on 127.0.0.1; no real credentials or model calls",
        sourceFailure=prior_failure(), baseline=verify(before, False), current=verify(after, True))
    report = HERE.parent / "building-loop-efficiency-stage/recovery-native-0.7.5.json"
    report.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=result["passed"], runtimeSha256=result["runtimeSha256"], cases=len(result["current"]))))

cases.beforeStateCommit: SIGKILL after projection write, before state rename; reopened old checkpoint, all pre-commit ledger, history, host and workspace rolling backup bytes restored, then retry completes
cases.partialProjection: SIGKILL after only new history rename; reopened ledger and history exact prior bytes
cases.afterStateCommit: SIGKILL after state rename and before returning; reopened committed projection and replay returned closed without replacing its backups
cases.interruptedRecovery: SIGKILL again partway through restoring an uncommitted projection; third open resumed from known already restored bytes
cases.conflictsBeforeCommit: External edit or authorization change after SIGKILL preserves all current targets and the journal, allows recovery once expected authority and bytes are restored
cases.conflictsAfterCommit: External ledger edit after committed SIGKILL remains intact; transaction requires explicit reconciliation
cases.lockOwner: Live PID and unrecognized old-format lock cannot be stolen; interrupted owner cleanup leaves only reclaimable empty directory
cases.windowsInitialClaimRetry: Transient EPERM, EBUSY and EACCES followed by a real successful rename. State, generated ledger and backups match original bytes at every blocked attempt.
cases.windowsInitialClaimExhaustion: Persistent denial exits at five attempts with the original exception; exact original bytes and clean staged claim retained.
cases.windowsInitialClaimCompetitor: A live owner at the post-error check or unknown owner arriving during the first delay is untouched; no second rename.

data.proof: Actual separate Node child processes killed using SIGKILL at production rename boundaries inside isolated temporary project and host directories. Uses registered production workflow handlers with test host identities, no Desktop writes or model calls. Windows claim fault cases inject only the exact initial rename while other registered-handler operations execute normally on the real Windows filesystem.
bounds: Generated ledger projection, per-file history, rolling backups and its authoritative host state only
Legacy file locks, reused or inaccessible live PIDs, unknown bytes and changed authority fail closed
No physical power-loss durability claim or automatic removal of abandoned private temp staging paths
Only Windows initial claim publication is retried, up to four bounded pauses totaling 185 ms; no retry for a present competing lock or after an operation starts.

from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
import json

stage = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
package = stage / 'package'
metrics = json.loads((stage.parent / 'building-loop-efficiency-audit/release-metrics.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
rows = {row['run']: row for row in metrics['rows']}
native = '''最终付费模型对照停在 **93 项回归对应的冻结版本**。用户随后要求收尾并停止追加付费测试；最后的局部边界修补形成 99 项版本，仅完成本地回归、独立代码复核和无模型 DSH 探针，没有把旧真实结果移作新版本验收。

| 最新实际运行 | 总 Token | 未缓存输入 | 缓存读取 | 输出 | 输入缓存命中 | 工具错误／模型中断 | 补查轮次 | 已知估费 USD | 主验收 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
'''
for stamp, label, verdict in (
    ('20261107T161408Z', '复用', '待澄清范围；核验证明仍有不实描述'),
    ('20261107T161418Z', '新开', '正文、账本与闭环通过；过程警示保留'),
):
    row = rows[stamp]
    u = row['usage']
    native += f"| [{label} {stamp[9:]}](data/building-loop-efficiency-audit/{stamp}.json) | {u['totalTokens']:,} | {u['inputTokens']:,} | {u['cacheReadTokens']:,} | {u['outputTokens']:,} | {u['cacheHitRate']:.2%} | {row['toolErrors']}／{row['turnErrors']} | {row['supplementRounds']} | {row['knownEstimatedUSD']} | {verdict} |\n"
native += '''
两组都正确退回三个种子错误、保留七个正确对照，宿主机械闭环与实际用量/角色权限验证通过，七项账本的取消、覆盖和保留与新目标一致。新开组最终正文 14 行、两审各 21 块；复用组 29 行、各 45 块。长度和返工路径不同，费用差不能作为复用策略的因果收益。

复用组的“群体层面”没有明确写求平均或聚合单位，合理地读作对这一组模拟观测的描述时可以成立；读作统计层级则缺少来源说明。正式复核保留 `needs-scope-clarification`，确定虚假正文事实计数为 0，不能把歧义当作已经证实的虚假事实。两审额外声称各引用处均写了“模拟”或“本例”，其中两处实际没有；统一来源声明不支持这个逐处标注断言，核验证明可靠性问题独立保留。敏感性复核前的较强派生裁决另存并标明已取代，原始实验文件未改。

复用组第二轮补查包含一次可避免的格式误退：已经标明“错例（字段混滑）：……——错在……”仍被要求改成严格的“错例：”。最终代码以统一、有限括号标签语法修复，实际原句和正反例本地回放通过；仍要求真实反证。新开组的过程自评计数、首次过度判为矛盾和最终简表的旧名称单独记录，没有当成最终正文错误，也没有从过程成本中删除。

'''
report = package / 'experiments/results-0.7.0.md'
text = report.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
start, end = '<!-- NATIVE_RESULTS_START -->', '<!-- NATIVE_RESULTS_END -->'
assert text.count(start) == text.count(end) == 1
text = text[:text.index(start)] + native.rstrip() + text[text.index(end)+len(end):]
known_total = metrics['knownTotals']['totalTokens'] + 7_179_903 + 51_051 + 74_758
known_cost = Decimal(metrics['knownEstimatedUSD']) + Decimal('0.05549751') + Decimal('0.026176804') + Decimal('0.064201532')

'''

text = text.replace('## 失败也计入成本\n\n', '## 失败也计入成本\n\n' + cost_text)
report.write_bytes(text.encode('utf-8'))

ledger = package / 'docs/task-ledger.md'
lines = ledger.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.startswith('| R23 |'):
        lines[i] = '| R23 | 本轮机制修补／已交付；语义边界转 R18 | 中性核验派单、宿主完整账本、unlisted 对齐实际退回片段、精准补查指纹与分类重核原因已经落实。最终 99 项本地回归及独立代码复核通过；真实 93 项 pair 新开组正文/账本通过，复用组仍待澄清范围且证明有不实逐处标记。误退括号错例、软换行与代码围栏边界已本地修复，未追加付费模型验证，不能标为最终版全部实测通过。 |'
    elif line.startswith('| R09 |'):
        lines[i] = '| R09 | 调用与纠错机制／已交付，收益未泛化 | 首次请求前收窄工具、按实际范围读包、紧凑状态、增量证明及错位反馈、成功通知后结束子轮、audit 不重发全文均已落实。最终 99 项本地回归通过，全部付费成功失败及参数纠错成本保留。最新真实 pair 工具错误为复用 2／新开 6，但正文长度和补查不同，不能据此宣布稳定节省。详情见 [0.7.0 报告](../experiments/results-0.7.0.md)。 |'
    elif line.startswith('2026-11-07 本轮目标：'):
        lines[i] = line + ' 2026-11-08 收尾决定：用户要求控制本轮消耗，收齐子 Agent 后只完成必要本地验证、同步与 Git 归档，不再启动付费模型实验；后续任务仅保留待重新规划，换模型接手时先读当前结果。'
ledger.write_bytes(('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode('utf-8'))
overview = package / 'README.md'

needle = '## 分块入口\n'
assert body.count(needle) == 1

name: agent-building-loop
description: "新建或大改 agent，明确职责、接口、三级文件与可验收的运行闭环。"
---

# Agent 建设与大改

新建 agent、改变职责、阶段、接口或重构三件套时使用。小修走[日常维护](../agent-three-piece-maintenance/SKILL.md)。这里定义建设和验收 agent 的方法，运行时的派单细则以该模式和项目的现行契约为准。

## 七步按风险落实

1. **确认任务和角色**。先核目标、产物、范围、权限和成功条件。读有效三件套、项目规则、真实输入和输出，找到直接生产者、消费者和权威文件。行动前用这些边界对照；会改变交付或副作用的歧义先问清。总控只管全貌、进度、任务和指定中央文件。需要调查或修改正文时，由获授权的执行方接单。
2. **比较依据和取舍**。新建或大改主动查相关成熟实现，回到官方文档、原始数据或代码，记版本、日期和定位。解释成立条件、代价、适用范围及取舍。将事实、推测和未知分开，引用能打开后仍需核对是否支持结论。发现漏源、错配或过期时退回补查。结论无足够证据时留待核。
3. **设计可执行规则**。写明谁在何时读什么、产出什么、谁验收、阻塞或退回怎么恢复。给同一分块、角色、权限匹配的执行会话留可查的复用引用，记录换会话的原因。把可判定的门槛放进工具或工作流。补查按退回项核结论是否改正、可定位证据是否补齐，有原始数据时先按口径复算并核单位，通过后再送审。创作质量用可判断的内容标准。后续、临时和中断事项记入项目账本，每轮交付后结合最新项目现状复盘，逐项决定保留、续做、延期、已完成、已被覆盖或失效并记依据。按需给消歧例子，保留创作空间。
4. **用专业视角挑错**。沿真实输入到产出走一遍，追原因、接口和执行点，检查遗漏、回滚、边界、反例、反对证据和更合适的替代。验证证据是否对得上具体断言。代码交付逐功能注释职责与输入输出，接口传递、跨模块状态、回滚重试和高耦合关键行交代调用方向、约束与理由。控制同步面和上下文成本。
5. **按影响审查**。高影响交付复核关键断言和回归，使用被允许且可用的独立审查或独立工具。记录复核者、范围和证据。仅自审时如实标明。需要盲读时明确材料开放时点和实际供料。来源核验方只读，补查和修改交原执行方。验收给出与受审版本对应的判断依据，核资料可信度、结论及边界、方法、备选的取舍、分层与必要细节，以及给读者的一句大白话。 独立核验的派单避免夹带前审结论；需要共同纠错时明确开放范围。复合断言分别核独立限定，证据要证明当前主张的对象；产物自身的数量、标注与完整性须检查当前产物。结构覆盖、不同会话或同厂商多模型一致都不等于语义真实。
6. **走真实入口验证**。覆盖代表性成功、失败、重试和接手场景，核实际执行点和下游消费。区分静态检查、隔离运行、模拟与真实生产。[无状态测试](../stateless-agent-testing/SKILL.md)用于真实契约为逐步独立调用的 agent。测试只用允许的输入、权限和环境。 比较复用与换会话时分开记录质量、未缓存输入、缓存读取、输出和失败成本；累计缓存读取不是上下文长度。总工作量未知时在落盘边界按实际用量判断交接，用同工作量及跨话题结果验证候选范围，未证实的阈值不设通用默认。
7. **交付前再核一次**。按用户原要求逐项读回改动，检查数据、来源、日志、实际消费者和有效版本。审视反例、遗漏及盲区。用可复核的证据交代完成范围，明确哪些仍不清楚。

## 文件与所有权

- 开工先按一级总纲、二级分块索引、三级实质内容规划并明确维护人。优先复用现有中央文件和结构。新增、调整在对应章节落地，由各层维护者同批同步，从一级复查到变更处。接手和上下文恢复从现行文件、最近交接和证据恢复，只读所需正文及更新记录。
- 每个受管文件对应唯一更新日志，记版本或日期、位置、原因、来源及验证。正文保留当前有效规则。修改按[安全写入](../file-write-best-practices/SKILL.md)处理，改前只保留一份固定滚动备份，同批一次，无变化不写。日志在同一文件记录自身变更，首次新建从首条日志开始。
- 规则归属看项目现行分层。共享命名和接口登记由指定维护者负责。范围外的 agent、中央文件和运行配置需要各自的维护权限；同步需求记路径、现文、期望和验收方式，交对应负责人。项目已有版本和编号制度时按现行制度。

交付写清变更位置、影响、事实依据和实测结果，再列推测及未验证项。最后用一个能核对的例子、数字或直白说明帮助用户判断是否达标。

# SKILL.md 更新日志

## 2026-11-08

- 根据 0.7.0 实际失败补充核验供料隔离、独立限定与证据对象对齐；明确结构和同源多审不能保证语义真实。
- 补充未知总工作量下的实际用量交接比较：质量、缓存及失败分账，跨话题验证后再考虑默认阈值。保留本技能的通用建设范围，不硬编码 DSH 参数或数值。
- 同批维护本日志；技能格式校验与引用入口读回另行记录，实测证据见 dsh-building-loop 的 0.7.0 报告。

## 2026-11-07

- 补充后续、临时与中断任务账本及按最新现状逐项复盘，补充功能、接口和高耦合位置的代码注释要求。
- 建设步骤补充逐条退回门槛、按原始数据复算并校对单位，以及绑定受审版本的独立质量判断。依据为 DSH building-loop 的补查实测与本轮交付要求。

## 2026-11-06

- 建设步骤增加开工消歧、总控与执行分离、原始来源核验、子会话复用、阻塞恢复和交付前盲区检查。保留按风险审查与从真实入口验证的区分。
- 文件规则明确三级路由、逐文件日志、单份改前备份和接手按需读取。保留日常维护、安全写入、无状态验证三个入口。
- 使用技能校验器检查 frontmatter 和技能名，并读回三个引用入口。
- 依据为用户本轮十二条要求。分层借鉴 Antora 的模块导航，续做借鉴 LangGraph 的同一线程恢复，验收借鉴 Kubernetes KEP 的测试计划和回滚检查。[Antora](https://docs.antora.org/antora/latest/navigation/organize-files/) · [LangGraph](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts) · [KEP](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/6ab9bf717d1228928740bdbfe761b6e62b870902/keps/NNNN-kep-template/README.md)

"""Copy the clean 0.6.0 source bytes into one isolated 0.7.0 working stage."""
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import json,subprocess

stage=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=stage.parent/'building-loop'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=repo)
assert not (stage/'baseline.json').exists()
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo).decode().strip()
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z'],cwd=repo).decode().split('\0')
baseline={}
for name in filter(None,files):
    file=repo/name
    assert file.resolve().is_relative_to(repo.resolve()) and not file.is_symlink()
    raw=file.read_bytes();baseline[name]=sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    target=stage/'package'/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(raw)

"""Publish a validated stage with pre-edit hashes and one rolling backup."""
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile

stage = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
package = stage / 'package'
repo = stage.parent / 'building-loop'
baseline = json.loads((stage / 'baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
backups = stage.parent / 'latest_backup/building-loop/package'
batch = '2026-11-07-building-loop-0.7.0-efficiency'
initial = set(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', (stage/'base-commit.txt').read_text().strip()], cwd=repo).decode().splitlines())


def atomic(path, data, previous):
    """Compare again immediately before replacing the same-volume temp file."""
    assert path.resolve() == path
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, prefix='.building-loop-stage-', delete=False) as stream:
        temporary = Path(stream.name)
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    try:
        assert temporary.read_bytes() == data
        assert (path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None) == previous, 'Concurrent edit: ' + str(path)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    assert path.read_bytes() == data


assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=repo), 'Repo has pending changes'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=repo).decode().strip() == (stage/'base-commit.txt').read_text().strip()
files = {p.relative_to(package).as_posix(): p for p in package.rglob('*')
         if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and not p.name.endswith('.bak')}
operations = []
for name, source in files.items():
    target = repo / name
    before = target.read_bytes() if target.is_file() else None
    assert (sha256(before).hexdigest() if before is not None else None) == baseline.get(name), 'Local drift: ' + name
    after = source.read_bytes()
    if before != after:
        operations.append((name, target, before, after))
for name, target, before, after in operations:
    if before is None or name not in initial:
        continue
    backup = repo/'INDEX.json.bak' if name == 'INDEX.json' else backups/name
    marker = backups/(name+'.rollback.json')
    old_meta = marker.read_bytes() if marker.is_file() else None
    meta = json.loads(old_meta) if old_meta else {}
    if meta.get('batch') == batch:
        assert meta['sha256After'] == sha256(before).hexdigest()
        assert sha256(backup.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == meta['sha256Before']
        meta['sha256After'] = sha256(after).hexdigest()
    else:
        atomic(backup, before, backup.read_bytes() if backup.is_file() else None)
        meta = dict(batch=batch, source=str(target), sha256Before=sha256(before).hexdigest(),
                    sha256After=sha256(after).hexdigest(), restoreFrom=str(backup))
    atomic(marker, (json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n').encode('utf-8'), old_meta)
for name, target, before, after in operations:
    atomic(target, after, before)
print('Published and read back', len(operations), 'files')

    return sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def qualify(ids):
    stage = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    repo = stage.parent / 'building-loop'
    smoke = stage.parent / 'building-loop-efficiency-index-validation'
    runs = stage.parent.parent / 'outputs/building-loop-efficiency-audit'
    previous = read(stage / 'layout-pair-inputs-0.7.7.json')
    fixture = read(stage / 'paired-fixture-0.7.7-required-object-markers.json')
    metadata, policies = {}, {}
    for group, run in zip(('reuse', 'fresh'), ids, strict=True):
        folder = runs / run
        details = read(folder / 'run.json')
        assert details.pop('groups') == [group] and details['excerptScopeGoal']
        assert details['requiredLinesControl']['seedLines'] == fixture['requiredLines']
        assert details['retainedSimulationScope'] == fixture['retainedSimulationScope']
        assert details['requiredObjectMarkers'] == fixture['requiredObjectMarkers']
        assert details['requiredCitationProfile'] == fixture['requiredCitationProfile']
        expected = details['runtimeHashes']
        copied = folder / 'isolated-home/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-building-loop'
        assert expected == {name: digest(copied / name) for name in expected} == {name: digest(repo / name) for name in expected}
        assert fixture['pairedInputHashes'] == {name: digest(folder / name) for name in fixture['pairedInputHashes']}
        policy = read(folder / group / 'workspace/BUILDING-LOOP.json')
        assert policy['units']['K01'].pop('continuation') == group and policy['requiredLinesGoal'] == 'PROJECT.md'
        metadata[group], policies[group] = details, policy
    assert metadata['reuse'] == metadata['fresh'] and policies['reuse'] == policies['fresh']
    delta = {name: {'before': previous['runtimeHashes'][name], 'after': value}
             for name, value in expected.items() if value != previous['runtimeHashes'][name]}
    assert set(delta) == {'governance/goals.mjs', 'governance/preflight.mjs'}
    case_delta = [name for name,value in fixture['pairedInputHashes'].items() if value != previous['caseFiles'][name]]
    assert case_delta == ['goal-after.md']

    crash = read(stage / 'crash-recovery-0.7.7.json')
    omission = read(smoke / 'r077-review-omissions-replay.json')
    retention = read(smoke / 'r077-required-lines-replay.json')
    enumeration = read(smoke / 'r077-source-line-enumeration-replay.json')
    simulation = read(smoke / 'r077-retained-simulation-goal-replay.json')
    scope = read(smoke / 'r077-simulation-source-preflight-replay.json')
    label = read(smoke / 'r077-supplement-label-replay.json')
    profile = read(smoke / 'r077-required-profile-replay.json')
    assert all(row['passed'] for row in (crash, omission, retention, enumeration, simulation, scope, label, profile))
    assert all(expected[name] == value for row in (crash, retention, simulation, scope, profile) for name, value in row['runtimeHashes'].items())
    assert profile['goalSha256'] == fixture['pairedInputHashes']['goal-after.md']
    assert omission['runtimeAfter'] == expected['governance/index.mjs']
    assert enumeration['runtimeSha256'] == expected['governance/coverage.mjs']
    assert label['runtimeAfter'] == expected['governance/coverage.mjs']
    result = {'runs': ids, 'previousRuns': previous['runs'], 'scopeSourceRuns': previous['previousRuns'],
              'simulationRuns': previous['simulationRuns'],
              'excerptRuns': previous['excerptRuns'], 'retentionRuns': previous['retentionRuns'],
              'attributionRuns': previous['attributionRuns'], 'symmetricRuns': previous['symmetricRuns'],
              'exploratoryRuns': previous['exploratoryRuns'], 'runtimeDelta': delta, 'provider': details['provider'],
              'model': details['model'], 'runtimeHashes': expected, 'caseFiles': fixture['pairedInputHashes'],
              'caseDelta': case_delta, 'policyDelta': [],
              'policiesDifferOnlyByContinuation': True, 'processCrashVerified': True, 'omissionReplayVerified': True,
              'retentionReplayVerified': True, 'enumerationReplayVerified': True, 'simulationGoalReplayVerified': True,
              'simulationSourcePreflightReplayVerified': True, 'supplementLabelReplayVerified': True,
              'requiredCitationProfileReplayVerified': True}
    write(stage / 'release-pair-inputs-0.7.7.json', result)

    stdout = smoke / 'regression-0.7.7-release.stdout.txt'
    stderr = smoke / 'regression-0.7.7-release.stderr.txt'
    log = stdout.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    counts = {key: int(re.search(fr'\b{key} (\d+)\s*$', log, re.M).group(1)) for key in ('tests', 'pass', 'fail')}
    assert counts['tests'] >= 230 and counts['tests'] == counts['pass'] and counts['fail'] == 0
    write(smoke / 'regression-0.7.7-release.json', {'command': 'node --test', 'passed': True, 'counts': counts,
          'runtimeHashes': expected, 'stdoutSha256': digest(stdout), 'stderrSha256': digest(stderr)})
    print(json.dumps({'runs': ids, 'runtime': len(expected), 'case': len(fixture['pairedInputHashes']), 'counts': counts}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('runs', nargs=2, metavar='RUN', help='Reuse followed by fresh')
    qualify(parser.parse_args().runs)

"""Check the prepared release, without changing its data or verdicts."""
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import re

stage=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
package=stage/'package'
repo=stage.parent/'building-loop'
baseline=json.loads((stage/'baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
old_manifest=json.loads((repo/'experiments/data/index.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
manifest=json.loads((package/'experiments/data/index.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
old_runs=old_manifest['runs']
assert len(old_runs)==67
for row in old_runs:
    before=(repo/'experiments/data'/row['path']).read_bytes()
    after=(package/'experiments/data'/row['path']).read_bytes()
    assert before==after, 'Historical run changed: '+row['path']

entries=json.loads((package/'INDEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['entries']
for entry in entries:
    raw=(package/entry['path']).read_bytes()
    assert len(raw)==entry['bytes'] and sha256(raw).hexdigest()==entry['sha256'], 'Stale layered index: '+entry['path']

secrets=[value.encode() for key,value in os.environ.items()
         if re.search(r'API_KEY|TOKEN|PASSWORD|SECRET',key,re.I) and len(value)>=12]
changed=[]
max_bytes=0
files=[p for p in package.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and not p.name.endswith('.bak')]
for file in files:
    name=file.relative_to(package).as_posix()
    raw=file.read_bytes()
    max_bytes=max(max_bytes,len(raw))
    assert len(raw)<100*1024*1024, 'File exceeds GitHub size limit: '+name
    assert not any(secret in raw for secret in secrets), 'Credential found in '+name
    assert not re.search(rb'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----',raw), 'Private key material in '+name
    if sha256(raw).hexdigest()==baseline.get(name) or name.startswith('changes/'):continue
    changed.append(name)
    assert (package/'changes'/(name+'.md')).is_file(), 'Missing per-file change log: '+name
    if file.suffix=='.md':
        text=raw.decode('utf-8')
        assert not re.search(r'<!-- (?:NATIVE|ARCHIVE)_RESULTS_START -->',text), 'Unfinished release section: '+name
        for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
            if re.match(r'^(?:[a-z]+:|#)',target,re.I):continue
            path=target.split('#',1)[0].split(' "',1)[0]
            if path and not any(c in path for c in ('{','}')):
                assert (file.parent/path).exists(), 'Broken local link in '+name+': '+path
result={'historicalRunsByteIdentical':len(old_runs),'releaseRuns':len(manifest['runs']),
        'layeredEntriesVerified':len(entries),'changedFilesWithOwnLog':len(changed),
        'filesScanned':len(files),'largestFileBytes':max_bytes,'credentialsFound':False,
        'limits':'Known environment credentials and private key markers were scanned. This is not semantic validation.'}
# This operational result is outside the archived input trees, avoiding a
# report claiming to hash the archive which contains the report itself.
destination=stage.parent/'building-loop-release-validation'
destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(destination/'release-check.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
print(json.dumps(result))

folder=Path(r'$USERPROFILE\.agents\skills\agent-building-loop')
target=folder/'SKILL.md'
prior=target.read_bytes()
text=prior.decode('utf-8-sig')
anchor='验收给出与受审版本对应的判断依据，核资料可信度、结论及边界、方法、备选的取舍、分层与必要细节，以及给读者的一句大白话。'
addition=' 独立核验的派单避免夹带前审结论；需要共同纠错时明确开放范围。复合断言分别核独立限定，证据要证明当前主张的对象；产物自身的数量、标注与完整性须检查当前产物。结构覆盖、不同会话或同厂商多模型一致都不等于语义真实。'
anchor2='测试只用允许的输入、权限和环境。'
addition2=' 比较复用与换会话时分开记录质量、未缓存输入、缓存读取、输出和失败成本；累计缓存读取不是上下文长度。总工作量未知时在落盘边界按实际用量判断交接，用同工作量及跨话题结果验证候选范围，未证实的阈值不设通用默认。'
assert anchor in text and anchor2 in text and addition not in text
after=text.replace(anchor,anchor+addition,1).replace(anchor2,anchor2+addition2,1).replace('\r\n','\n').encode('utf-8')
log=folder/'CHANGELOG.md'
old_log=log.read_bytes()
entry='## 2026-11-08\n\n- 根据 0.7.0 实际失败补充核验供料隔离、独立限定与证据对象对齐；明确结构和同源多审不能保证语义真实。\n- 补充未知总工作量下的实际用量交接比较：质量、缓存及失败分账，跨话题验证后再考虑默认阈值。保留本技能的通用建设范围，不硬编码 DSH 参数或数值。\n- 同批维护本日志；技能格式校验与引用入口读回另行记录，实测证据见 dsh-building-loop 的 0.7.0 报告。\n\n'
old_text=old_log.decode('utf-8').replace('\r\n','\n')

new_log=(first+'\n\n'+entry+rest).encode('utf-8')
batch='2026-11-08-building-loop-0.7.0-skill'
backup_root=stage.parent/'latest_backup/building-loop/host-skill/agent-building-loop'
changes=[]
for file,before,new in ((target,prior,after),(log,old_log,new_log)):
    backup_root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

    marker=backup.with_suffix(backup.suffix+'.rollback.json')

    backup.write_bytes(before)

        'sha256After':sha256(new).hexdigest(),'restoreFrom':str(backup)},indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=folder,prefix='.building-loop-skill-',delete=False) as stream:

"""Capture final regression evidence and compare it to the frozen runtime."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

stage = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
package = stage / 'package'
destination = stage.parent / 'building-loop-efficiency-index-validation'
destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

files = sorted((package / 'test').glob('*.test.mjs'))
before = {p.relative_to(package).as_posix(): sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for folder in ('governance', 'test') for p in (package / folder).glob('*.mjs')}
# Each frozen runtime gets its own immutable Node reporter output. Earlier
# successful terminal-only checks had no saved artifact; subsequent code changes
# need a new regression result rather than overwriting the prior evidence.
identity = sha256(json.dumps(before, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
prefix = destination / ('regression-' + identity)
assert not prefix.with_suffix('.json').exists(), 'This exact runtime/test set already has saved regression evidence'
result = subprocess.run(['node', '--test', *map(str, files)], cwd=package,
                        capture_output=True, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
prefix.with_suffix('.stdout.txt').write_bytes(result.stdout)
prefix.with_suffix('.stderr.txt').write_bytes(result.stderr)
assert before == {name: sha256((package / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in before}
record = {'timeUTC': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'exitCode': result.returncode,
          'command': ['node', '--test', *[p.relative_to(package).as_posix() for p in files]],
          'runtimeAndTestHashes': before, 'stdoutSha256': sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),
          'format': 'Node default test reporter; UTF-8',
          'reason': 'Evidence capture for this frozen 0.7.0 runtime and test set.'}
prefix.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert result.returncode == 0, 'See saved regression output'
print('\n'.join(result.stdout.decode('utf-8').splitlines()[-9:]))

"""Compare the qualified runtime, actual Desktop installation, backups and loaded probe bytes."""
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import json


def digest(file):
    return sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def verify(probe, version):
    stage = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    repo = stage.parent / 'building-loop'
    desktop = Path.home() / '.dsh'
    installed = desktop / 'profiles/desktop'
    loaded = probe / 'isolated-home/profiles/web'
    manifest = json.loads((stage / f'desktop-install-{version}.json').read_bytes())
    proof = manifest['verifiedBy']
    assert proof['acceptedBoth'] and len(proof['pair']) == 2
    assert digest(stage / 'recovery-native-0.7.5.json') == proof['nativeRecoverySha256']
    verified_replays = {}
    if version == '0.7.7':
        replay = stage.parent/'building-loop-efficiency-index-validation'
        for field, path in {
            'processCrashRecoverySha256': stage/'crash-recovery-0.7.7.json',
            'reviewOmissionReplaySha256': replay/'r077-review-omissions-replay.json',
            'requiredLinesReplaySha256': replay/'r077-required-lines-replay.json',
            'sourceLineEnumerationReplaySha256': replay/'r077-source-line-enumeration-replay.json',
            'simulationGoalReplaySha256': replay/'r077-retained-simulation-goal-replay.json',
            'simulationSourcePreflightReplaySha256': replay/'r077-simulation-source-preflight-replay.json',
            'supplementLabelReplaySha256': replay/'r077-supplement-label-replay.json',
            'requiredCitationProfileReplaySha256': replay/'r077-required-profile-replay.json',
        }.items():
            assert digest(path) == proof[field], path
            verified_replays[field] = proof[field]
    # Compare with both real trial manifests, not just the current checkout.
    hashes = proof['pair'][0]['runtimeHashes']
    assert hashes == proof['pair'][1]['runtimeHashes']
    modules = {}
    for name in (path.removeprefix('governance/') for path in hashes if path.startswith('governance/')):
        paths = (repo / 'governance' / name, installed / 'building-loop-governance' / name, loaded / 'building-loop-governance' / name)
        assert {digest(path) for path in paths} == {hashes['governance/' + name]}, name
        modules[name] = hashes['governance/' + name]
    for name, paths in {
        'turn-resume/index.mjs': (installed / 'turn-resume/index.mjs', loaded / 'turn-resume/index.mjs'),
        'skills/dispatch-protocol/SKILL.md': (desktop / 'presets/paidan/skills/dispatch-protocol/SKILL.md',
            loaded / 'node_modules/dsh-building-loop/skills/dispatch-protocol/SKILL.md'),
    }.items():
        assert {digest(path) for path in (repo / name, *paths)} == {hashes[name]}, name
    for row in manifest['files']:
        relative = Path(row['path'])
        target = desktop / relative
        backup = desktop / '_backups/latest_backup' / relative
        assert digest(target) == row['after'], relative
        if row['before'] is not None:
            assert digest(backup) == row['before'], relative
        if version == '0.7.7':

def error_history():
    """Extract exact actual judgment entries from the preserved first review.

    The resulting assistant message is a constructed diagnostic history; its
    original form was a DSH coverage tool call, not an API assistant text answer.
    """
    run=WORKSPACE/'outputs/building-loop-coverage-audit/20261107T131714Z'
    events=[json.loads(line) for line in (run/'events.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
    summary=json.loads((run/'summary.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    sid=summary['firstReview']['reviewer']
    found=[];locations=[]
    for event in events:
        if event['sid']!=sid or event['type']!='tool/call' or event['data'].get('name')!='building_loop_coverage':continue
        args=json.loads(event['data']['arguments'])
        if args.get('action')!='record':continue
        for entry in args.get('entries',[]):
            if entry['block'] not in {'B8-823a4f98','B10-4cfcf82d','B12-6632db56'}:continue
            if any(x['block']==entry['block'] for x in found):continue
            found.append(entry)
            locations.append({'session':sid,'seq':event.get('seq'),'callId':event['data']['callId'],'block':entry['block']})
        if len(found)==3:break
    assert len(found)==3 and all(e['parts'][0]['status']=='supported' for e in found)
    # Preserve the actual entries verbatim at the JSON value level, including the
    # wrong rationale. Do not rewrite them to manufacture a stronger failure.
    text='上一轮核验记录：\n'+json.dumps({'entries':found},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    provenance={'kind':'constructed-history-from-real-tool-call','sourceRun':'20261107T131714Z',
                'sourceEventsSha256':sha256((run/'events.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                'locations':locations,'entries':found,'assistantTextSha256':sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                'limitation':'Original entries came from tool-call arguments. We embed them as assistant text only for a controlled anchoring probe; this is not the original production conversation.'}
    return text,provenance

def usage_summary(raw,model):
    """Use provider usage; token totals never substitute for billed money."""
    u=raw.get('usage') or {}
    prompt=u.get('prompt_tokens');completion=u.get('completion_tokens')
    hit=u.get('prompt_cache_hit_tokens',u.get('prompt_tokens_details',{}).get('cached_tokens'))
    miss=u.get('prompt_cache_miss_tokens')
    if miss is None and hit is not None and prompt is not None:miss=prompt-hit
    known=all(isinstance(x,int) for x in (prompt,completion,hit,miss))
    amount={'providerRaw':u,'totalTokens':u.get('total_tokens'),'promptTokens':prompt,'outputTokens':completion,
            'cacheReadTokens':hit,'uncachedInputTokens':miss,'cacheHitRate':hit/prompt if known and prompt else None,
            'estimatedUSD':None,'pricing':{'ratesUSDPerMillion':RATES[model],'period':'offpeak',
              'source':'https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/','cacheDefinition':'https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/kv_cache/',
              'observedDate':'2026-11-07','basis':'Saturday off-peak; rates verified by parent before this fixed experiment',
              'limitation':'Calculation from returned usage, not a provider invoice. Missing failed-request usage remains unknown.'}}
    if known:
        assert prompt==hit+miss
        assert u['total_tokens']==prompt+completion
        r=RATES[model];amount['estimatedUSD']=(hit*r['cacheHit']+miss*r['cacheMiss']+completion*r['output'])/1_000_000
    return amount

def request(run,name,payload,key,metadata):
    """One authorized request, at most one transport/server-failure retry.

    Every attempt gets its own preserved record; semantic failure and malformed
    model JSON do not cause a retry. Authorization headers are never logged.
    """
    record={'id':name,'metadata':metadata,'request':payload,'requestSha256':digest(payload),'attempts':[]}
    for attempt in range(2):
        start=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();tic=time.monotonic()
        req=urllib.request.Request(API,data=encoded(payload),headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
        row={'attempt':attempt+1,'startedAt':start}
        retry=False
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=60) as response:
                raw=json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))
                row['httpStatus']=response.status
            # Only user-visible content is archived; disabled thinking is requested.
            for choice in raw.get('choices',[]):choice.get('message',{}).pop('reasoning_content',None)
            row['response']=raw;row['usage']=usage_summary(raw,payload['model'])
            record['response']=raw;record['usage']=row['usage']
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            row.update(httpStatus=exc.code,errorType=type(exc).__name__,errorBody=exc.read().decode('utf-8',errors='replace').replace(key,'[REDACTED]')[:4000])
            retry=exc.code in {408,429,500,502,503,504}
        except (urllib.error.URLError,TimeoutError,socket.timeout) as exc:
            row.update(errorType=type(exc).__name__,error=str(exc).replace(key,'[REDACTED]'))
            retry=True
        row.update(finishedAt=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),wallSeconds=time.monotonic()-tic)
        record['attempts'].append(row)
        write(run/'calls'/(name+'.json'),record)
        if 'response' in record or not retry or attempt==1:break
        time.sleep(1)
    return record

def analyze(record,expected):
    """Score exact presealed labels; no semantic verdict is inferred from HTTP 200."""
    out={'transportSuccess':'response' in record,'formatValid':False,'allCorrect':False}
    if not out['transportSuccess']:return out
    response=record['response'];choice=response.get('choices',[{}])[0]
    out['finishReason']=choice.get('finish_reason')
    content=choice.get('message',{}).get('content','')
    try:
        value=json.loads(content);rows=value['results']
        assert isinstance(rows,list) and len(rows)==len(expected)
        assert {r['id'] for r in rows}==set(expected)
        assert len({r['id'] for r in rows})==len(rows)
        assert all(r['verdict'] in {'pass','return'} and isinstance(r.get('reason'),str) and r['reason'].strip() and isinstance(r.get('sourceIds'),list) for r in rows)
        assert choice.get('finish_reason')=='stop'
    except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,AssertionError) as exc:
        out['formatError']=type(exc).__name__;return out
    out.update(formatValid=True,results=rows,
               errors=[{'id':r['id'],'expected':expected[r['id']],'observed':r['verdict'],'reason':r['reason']} for r in rows if r['verdict']!=expected[r['id']]])
    out['falseAccepts']=sum(r['verdict']=='pass' and expected[r['id']]=='return' for r in rows)
    out['falseRejects']=sum(r['verdict']=='return' and expected[r['id']]=='pass' for r in rows)
    out['allCorrect']=not out['errors']
    return out

This diagnostic preserves complete real artifacts, changes only the model ID and
exposure to an exact earlier acceptance statement, and includes minimal repaired
controls. It is a targeted post-discovery HTTP probe, not a production DSH run or
a preregistered generalization benchmark. No credential is written to disk.

def file_ref(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {"path": path.relative_to(WORKSPACE).as_posix(),
            "sha256": sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "bytes": len(raw)}


def substantive_lines(text):
    """Cover every nonblank nonheading line, including caveats and closing prose."""
    return [i for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1)
            if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#")]


def fixed_materials():
    reuse = WORKSPACE / "outputs/building-loop-efficiency-audit/20261107T151713Z/reuse/workspace"

    edit_b = ("本文凡引用它的句子都标了“模拟”，不与下面的官方摘录混为一谈。",
              "本文将它作为模拟材料，与官方摘录分开说明。")

def fixed_prompt():
    """Reuse the current auditor method and evidence rules without targeting a word."""
    path = WORKSPACE / "work/building-loop-efficiency-stage/package/governance/index.mjs"
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    names = ("AUDIT_METHOD", "LITERAL_RULE", "EXAMPLE_RULE")
    extracted = {}
    for name in names:
        match = re.search(r"const " + name + r" = '([^'\n]*)';", text)
        assert match, name
        extracted[name] = match.group(1)
    prefix = """你是独立资料与推导核验者。以下给定多份完整候选稿和来源；分别审查每一稿，不把另一稿的结论当证据。
按现行反证方法与同一证据标准判断：pass=该稿可按原样保留，return=至少一处必须作最小修正。
全文读取，包括正文后的括号、边界、材料说明、自我说明和收尾；复合句的每个判断都须成立。一行有任一不成立的实质判断，该行 return。
直接转述须与实际原文对应，推导检查前提、对象、条件、量词、方向、范围和反例。引用确实存在不代表支持这句话。
正确但简短的内容保留；阅读建议、标题及明确推测不强求捏造外部证据，显式错例须按展示错误的立场核验，不作为作者认可的事实。
"""
    suffix = """
这是一次性审读，材料已在本请求完整提供，不调用工具。上述 inventory/record 的标准照用，改用下面的输出接口。
输出严格 JSON：{"documents":[{"id":"D17","verdict":"pass|return","checks":[{"line":3,"quote":"该行逐字短摘录","evidence":"来源文件:行号 或 本稿:行号 或 无外部事实","verdict":"pass|return","basis":"简短具体理由"}]}]}。
每份稿覆盖 supplied requiredLines 的每个行号一次，不增删，不只挑疑点。quote 是该行逐字连续摘录（最多28个字符）；basis 最多45个汉字，必须核整行全部独立判断而非只核 quote。evidence 标明实际证据位置；可用稿件自身核稿件结构。若一行多个判断用同一行简短说明关键支持或反证。
稿 verdict 必须与逐行判断一致：任一行 return 则稿 return，全部 pass 才稿 pass。只输出可复查结论和短依据，不输出长篇思维过程。
"""
    prompt = prefix + "\n".join(extracted.values()) + suffix
    return prompt, {"source": file_ref(path), "constants": extracted,
                    "adaptation": "Same auditor/evidence criteria; direct supplied materials replace controlled file tools, line receipts replace production coverage API."}

def analyze(record, expected, fixed):
    out = {"transportSuccess": "response" in record, "formatValid": False, "allCorrect": False}
    if "response" not in record:
        return out
    try:
        choice = record["response"]["choices"][0]
        assert choice["finish_reason"] == "stop", "truncated response"
        obj = json.loads(choice["message"]["content"])
        documents = obj["documents"]
        assert len(documents) == 4 and {x["id"] for x in documents} == set(expected)
        for doc in documents:
            key = doc["id"]; rows = doc["checks"]
            assert doc["verdict"] in ("pass", "return")
            assert len(rows) == len(fixed["requiredLines"][key])
            assert {row["line"] for row in rows} == set(fixed["requiredLines"][key])
            lines = fixed["drafts"][key].splitlines()
            for row in rows:
                assert row["verdict"] in ("pass", "return")
                assert isinstance(row["quote"], str) and row["quote"] and row["quote"] in lines[row["line"] - 1]
                assert isinstance(row["evidence"], str) and row["evidence"].strip()
                assert isinstance(row["basis"], str) and row["basis"].strip()
            assert doc["verdict"] == ("return" if any(x["verdict"] == "return" for x in rows) else "pass")
    except (AssertionError, KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, IndexError) as exc:
        out["formatError"] = type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc)
        return out
    out.update(formatValid=True, documents=documents,
               errors=[{"id": x["id"], "expected": expected[x["id"]], "observed": x["verdict"]}
                       for x in documents if x["verdict"] != expected[x["id"]]])
    out["falseAccepts"] = sum(x["verdict"] == "pass" and expected[x["id"]] == "return" for x in documents)
    out["falseRejects"] = sum(x["verdict"] == "return" and expected[x["id"]] == "pass" for x in documents)
    out["allCorrect"] = not out["errors"]
    return out

def complete_documents(content):
    """Parse complete prefix objects; do not repair the truncated object."""
    value = content.find('"documents"')
    assert value >= 0
    start = content.find("[", value) + 1
    rows = []
    while start and start < len(content):
        while start < len(content) and content[start] in " \n\r\t,":
            start += 1
        try:
            row, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(content, start)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            break
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or "id" not in row:
            break
        rows.append(row)
        start = end
    return rows

    assert all(call["metadata"][k] == cell[k] for k in cell)

    groups = [totals, by_model.setdefault(cell["model"], Counter()), by_supply.setdefault(cell["supply"], Counter())]
    for group in groups:
        group["calls"] += 1
    last_success = None
    for attempt in call["attempts"]:

        response = attempt.get("response")

        response_id = response["id"]

        rates = {k: Decimal(str(v)) for k, v in normalized["pricing"]["ratesUSDPerMillion"].items()}

        assert abs(amount - Decimal(str(normalized["estimatedUSD"]))) < Decimal("0.000000000001")
        mapping = {"totalTokens": "total_tokens", "promptTokens": "prompt_tokens", "outputTokens": "completion_tokens",

        for dest, source in mapping.items():

    if last_success is not None:

    score = json.loads((run / "scores" / path.name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not last_success:

    choice = last_success["choices"][0]

    try:

        issues.append({"kind": "incomplete-json-or-document-set"})
    for doc in docs:
        key = doc["id"]; rows = doc["checks"]; source_lines = fixed["drafts"][key].splitlines()
        assert len(rows) == len(fixed["requiredLines"][key]) and {r["line"] for r in rows} == set(fixed["requiredLines"][key])
        assert doc["verdict"] == ("return" if any(x["verdict"] == "return" for x in rows) else "pass")
        for row in rows:

                issues.append({"kind": "nonliteral-quote", "document": key, "line": row["line"], "quote": row["quote"]})
        secondary["completeVisibleDocuments"] += 1
        secondary["falseAccepts"] += doc["verdict"] == "pass" and expected[key] == "return"
        secondary["falseRejects"] += doc["verdict"] == "return" and expected[key] == "pass"
        secondary["correct"] += doc["verdict"] == expected[key]
        target_line = 13 if key in ("D17", "D58") else 6
        visible.append({"call": call["id"], "document": key, "verdict": doc["verdict"],
                        "expected": expected[key], "targetRow": next(r for r in rows if r["line"] == target_line),
                        "primaryProtocolValid": score["formatValid"]})
    assert score["formatValid"] == (not issues), (path.name, issues)
    checks_manifest.append({"call": call["id"], "formatValid": not issues, "issues": issues,
                            "completeVisibleDocuments": len(docs), "finishReason": choice["finish_reason"]})
    if issues:
        formats["protocolFailures"] += 1
        for kind in {x["kind"] for x in issues}:
            formats[kind] += 1
    else:
        formats["completeProtocolValidCalls"] += 1
        for doc in docs:
            primary["documentJudgments"] += 1
            primary["falseAccepts"] += doc["verdict"] == "pass" and expected[doc["id"]] == "return"
            primary["falseRejects"] += doc["verdict"] == "return" and expected[doc["id"]] == "pass"

"""Recompute usage and strict quality from provider responses without rewriting them."""
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import json
import copy
import re
import run as harness

def audit_run(path):
    meta=harness.load(path/'run.json');spec=harness.load(path/'test-injections.json')
    facts=harness.load(path/'facts.json')
    checks=[];usage=[];changed=[];sessions=[];session_first=[];seen_sessions=set()
    for unitpath in sorted(path.glob('unit-*.json')):
        old=harness.load(unitpath);idx=old['unit']-1;case=spec['cases'][idx]
        request=harness.load(path/old['requestFile']);rawpath=path/f"response-{old['unit']:03}.json"
        wire=json.dumps(request['payload'],ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')
        integrity=sha256(wire).hexdigest()==request['payloadSha256']
        record=dict(unit=old['unit'],requestHashCorrect=integrity,originalQualified=old.get('evaluation',{}).get('qualified',False))
        if rawpath.exists():
            raw=harness.load(rawpath);choice=raw['choices'][0]
            try:answer=json.loads(choice['message'].get('content',''))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:answer=None
            goal=spec['updatedGoal'] if idx>=spec['updateAfter'] else spec['initialGoal']
            strict=harness.evaluate(case,answer,spec,goal,choice.get('finish_reason'))
            normalized=copy.deepcopy(answer)
            if isinstance(normalized,dict) and isinstance(normalized.get('evidence'),list):
                normalized['evidence']=[re.sub(r'^(.+):L(\d+)$',r'\1:L\2-L\2',r) if isinstance(r,str) else r for r in normalized['evidence']]
            normalized_eval=harness.evaluate(case,normalized,spec,goal,choice.get('finish_reason'))
            returned=harness.normalize_usage(raw.get('usage',{}));record['independentValidation']=strict
            record['normalizedSingleLineLocatorEvaluation']=normalized_eval
            record['parsedAnswer']=isinstance(answer,dict)
            record['goalFieldMismatchInParsedAnswer']=isinstance(answer,dict) and not strict['ruleCorrect']
            record['storedAnswerEqualsRaw']=old.get('answer')==answer
            record['storedUsageEqualsRaw']=old.get('usage')==returned
            record['finishReason']=choice.get('finish_reason')
            if returned:usage.append(returned)
            else:record['usageUnknown']=True
            if strict['qualified']!=record['originalQualified']:changed.append(old['unit'])
            sessions.append(old['sessionIndex'])
            if old['sessionIndex'] not in seen_sessions:
                session_first.append(dict(sessionIndex=old['sessionIndex'],unit=old['unit'],usage=returned,
                  checkpointBytes=len(request['payload']['messages'][1]['content'].encode('utf-8'))))
                seen_sessions.add(old['sessionIndex'])
        else:record.update(usageUnknown=True,independentValidation=dict(qualified=False))
        checks.append(record)
    def total(rows):
        return {key:sum(row[key] for row in rows) for key in ('inputTokens','cacheReadTokens','cacheWriteTokens','outputTokens','totalTokens','inputWithCacheTokens','estimatedUSD')}
    sums=total(usage)
    facts_ok=all(sha256(facts[name].encode()).hexdigest()==info['sha256'] for name,info in spec['files'].items())
    result=dict(run=path.name,topic=meta['topic'],purpose=meta.get('purpose'),threshold=meta['threshold'],
      plannedUnits=len(spec['cases']),observedUnits=len(checks),qualifiedUnits=sum(c['independentValidation']['qualified'] for c in checks),
      originalScoreChangedUnits=changed,allRequestHashesCorrect=all(c['requestHashCorrect'] for c in checks),factsHashesCorrect=facts_ok,
      allStoredUsageMatchesRaw=all(c.get('storedUsageEqualsRaw',False) for c in checks),unknownUsageRequests=sum(c.get('usageUnknown',False) for c in checks),
      usageMeaning='Known returned usage only. A run with unknownUsageRequests > 0 has unknown actual total and cost, not zero cost.',
      usage=sums,firstRequest=usage[0] if usage else None,subsequentRequests=total(usage[1:]),
      peakInputTokens=max((x['inputWithCacheTokens'] for x in usage),default=0),
      inputCacheHitRate=sums['cacheReadTokens']/sums['inputWithCacheTokens'] if sums['inputWithCacheTokens'] else None,
      sessionCount=len(set(sessions)),handoffs=max(sessions,default=0),
      sessionFirstRequests=session_first,
      handoffFirstRequestsUsage=total([x['usage'] for x in session_first if x['sessionIndex']>0 and x['usage']]),
      handoffCostMeaning='Full first-request cost after each handoff, already included in totals; not an estimate of marginal avoidable overhead.',
      validation=checks,limits=['All source locators must be well formed and in bounds; all expected locator groups must be met.',
        'Provider finish_reason must be stop; source locator overlap is not a standalone semantic entailment proof.',
        'Original records and original scores are not overwritten; this is an independent validation column.',
        'Unknown failed-request usage remains unknown; known returned usage only is summed.'])
    good=result['qualifiedUnits'];result['estimatedUSDPerQualifiedUnit']=sums['estimatedUSD']/good if good and not result['unknownUsageRequests'] else None
    result['postHocNormalizedLocatorQualifiedUnits']=sum(c.get('normalizedSingleLineLocatorEvaluation',{}).get('qualified',False) for c in checks)
    result['locatorExpressionOnlyRecoveredUnits']=[c['unit'] for c in checks if not c['independentValidation']['qualified'] and c.get('normalizedSingleLineLocatorEvaluation',{}).get('qualified',False)]
    result['postHocLimit']='Uniformly expands exact file:L16 to file:L16-L16 only, then performs every existing bound, expected-evidence, label, goal and finish check. Auxiliary retrospective analysis, not original score.'
    result['goalFieldMismatchesInParsedAnswers']=sum(c.get('goalFieldMismatchInParsedAnswer',False) for c in checks)
    result['unparseableAnswers']=sum('finishReason' in c and not c.get('parsedAnswer',False) for c in checks)
    result['nonStopResponses']=sum('finishReason' in c and c['finishReason']!='stop' for c in checks)
    if meta['topic']=='C' and meta.get('purpose')=='formal-threshold-comparison':
        selected=[c for c in checks if c['unit']!=25]
        result['excludingDisputedC25']=dict(observedUnits=len(selected),plannedUnits=len(spec['cases'])-1,
          originalStrictQualified=sum(c['independentValidation']['qualified'] for c in selected),
          postHocNormalizedLocatorQualified=sum(c.get('normalizedSingleLineLocatorEvaluation',{}).get('qualified',False) for c in selected),
          reason='The personal-data ban outranks restore phrase may invite a broader reading than its preceding export/publish-only condition; frozen oracle retained, sensitivity excludes it uniformly.')
    if (path/'state.json').exists():
        state=harness.load(path/'state.json');result['thresholdCrossings']=state.get('crossings',[])
    harness.save(path/'independent-validation.json',result)
    return result

def main():
    results=[audit_run(path) for path in sorted(harness.FAMILY.iterdir()) if path.is_dir() and (path/'summary.json').exists()]
    harness.save(harness.HERE/'independent-validation-summary.json',dict(runs=results,
      grandKnownUsage={key:sum(r['usage'][key] for r in results) for key in ('inputTokens','cacheReadTokens','outputTokens','totalTokens','estimatedUSD')},
      credentialHandling='Only environment key used by HTTP sender; no Authorization headers are retained.'))
    for r in results:print(json.dumps({k:r[k] for k in ('run','purpose','observedUnits','qualifiedUnits','originalScoreChangedUnits','allRequestHashesCorrect','factsHashesCorrect','usage')},ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Run an approved sequence once; preserve failures and stop on unknown usage."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import sys

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUTPUT=HERE.parents[1]/'outputs/building-loop-threshold-audit'

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--topic',required=True);p.add_argument('thresholds',type=int,nargs='+')
    args=p.parse_args()
    for threshold in args.thresholds:
        previous=set(OUTPUT.iterdir())
        result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(HERE/'run.py'),'--topic',args.topic,'--threshold',str(threshold),'--purpose','formal-threshold-comparison'])
        added=[x for x in set(OUTPUT.iterdir())-previous if x.is_dir() and f'-{args.topic}-' in x.name]
        if result.returncode or len(added)!=1:raise RuntimeError('Runner failed or run identity was ambiguous; no automatic retry')
        summary=json.loads((added[0]/'summary.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        print('ARM_SUMMARY '+json.dumps(dict(run=added[0].name,**summary),ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        if not summary['allWorkCompleted'] or summary['unknownUsageRequests'] or summary['failedRequests']:
            raise RuntimeError('Incomplete or unknown-usage arm preserved; batch stopped without retry')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

# 累计缓存读取阈值：受控 API 会话成本基准

本实验直接使用官方 DeepSeek HTTP API 控制消息，衡量同一话题在安全检查点交接后的成本与答案质量。它不是 DSH 工具流程验收；生产模式的复用／新开闭环由另一个实验运行。

阈值按一个工作会话中各请求实际返回的 `prompt_cache_hit_tokens` 累加。达到阈值后，先把当前答案、任务进度和当前规则落盘，再为下一项新建消息历史并重置会话累计值。项目累计值继续保留。不预知工作总量，不按固定会话数停，也不添加无效文本凑 Token。

各组完成同样的固定工作单元后停止。阈值只改变交接时间；同一话题内材料、问题顺序、规则更新点、模型和输出契约相同。新会话重新读取同样事实材料，并读取程序已落盘的完成 ID 和当前规则。交接额外输入计费，不额外调用模型写摘要。

A：冻结到 3b32121 的真实 0.6.0 治理实现，7 个有效源文件，24 个独立代码判断。前 12 项完成后目标从 G1 改为 G2；之后每个回答必须带当前规则与 scope。答案及代码证据定位封存于 spec，只把当前问题送给模型，不把判定或预期位置放进请求。

先运行 A 的第 1 项确认有效上下文长度、结构化输出和 usage 口径。第一次小样把含糊的 `ruleVersion` 理解为源代码规范版本，原始失败完整保留；经父任务批准将字段明确为 `goalVersion` 后另建全新校准轮，所有正式组使用同一新契约。校准完成 24 题后，实际累计缓存 1,013,760，取相邻候选 250k/500k/750k。A 正式组顺序为 500k→250k→750k→不换；最后的不换组用于避免第一次冷缓存给基线造成不公平劣势。不能为了让阈值触发而加长材料或重复问题。

后续 B/C 使用明确标注的合成运营记录与规则／例外案例，按相同工作量跨话题验证两个候选阈值与不换基线。组序轮换。服务端缓存冷热、并行外部调用及模型随机性未受完全控制，单次排序只作候选证据。

B 使用 640 条唯一合成运营记录、28,037 字节/654 行、24 个判断：8 组记录均进入总和或计数，原始数据可由脚本复算。G2 把成功率分母从全部请求改为已完成请求，明确全量的诊断延迟指标保持全量。C 最初使用 24 个独立合成授权档案以及总纲、模块条款、请求事实三层资料，共 22,838 字节/309 行；共享准备实测单次输入 7,120，合理推算 24 题不会触及 250k。正式组开始前，经父任务明确批准扩展为 36 个独立判断、33,003 字节/453 行；三个 C 正式组统一使用新材料，G2 更新点仍在第 12 题后。旧 24 题准备请求完整保留，费用单列，不混作 36 题结果。扩规模决策与新增项目见 adaptive-design.json；没有重复问题或无效填充。G2 实际停用 export/publish。

A 三个有限阈值均 24/24 合格，按每合格单元估价选 250k/750k 进入跨话题试验，但价差很小，选择只表示继续观察。B 次序不换→750k→250k；C 次序250k→不换→750k。每个新话题先做一次不含正式题目答案的共享读材准备，费用单独列出并纳入总实验成本，不混作合格工作单元。

质量评分必须同时满足：判定标签正确；全部来源定位合法且在界内；所需证据组有定位；保留当前目标版本与 scope；输出完整 JSON 且 `finish_reason=stop`。B 的汇总证据还必须覆盖所有参与计算的行。原始失败不自动重跑或修答案。另从原始响应独立重算 usage、请求 SHA、严格评分；历史原始评分不覆盖，追加独立核对列。定位只是机械前置检查，自然语言理由是否支持结论仍需单列审阅，不能冒称全自动语义证明。

每请求保存实际 messages、参数、SHA、原始回答、usage、UTC 时间与错误，排除密钥。未知失败用量不按零计；不为了满意结果重跑失败题。统计累计输入／输出、缓存命中、单次输入峰值、阈值超额、交接次数、标签与证据定位正确率、正确内容误退／错误内容漏放以及每合格单元的估计成本。

费用使用已核官方周末 Flash 价格：缓存命中输入 $0.003/M，未命中输入 $0.15/M，输出 $0.6/M。来源：https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/ 。这是按公开单价估算，不是实际账单；跨时段须重新核价格。缓存字段口径来源：https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/kv_cache/ 。

大白话：固定要干的活，只改变“读了多少缓存以后换会话”，看每做对一项到底花多少钱；不能先规定必须换几次，再往里面塞字把数字凑齐。

# 累计缓存阈值：真实 API 实测与边界

本轮没有足够证据设一个通用的“最省钱换会话阈值”。代码题中各档都能做对，但相对热缓存不换组的费用变化都不足 1%（最高与最低档相差约1.12%）；运营数据题存在实质判断错误，必须先解决质量；授权题主要受定位表达影响。两组遇到网络失败，未知费用保留为未知。

这是官方 DeepSeek HTTP API 的受控消息历史基准，不是 DSH 派单、工具、审查、账本完整流程验收。事实材料、题序和目标更新点在每个话题内一致；阈值按工作会话实际累计 `prompt_cache_hit_tokens` 触发，在答案落盘后安全交接。它不是单次上下文长度，也不是固定换几次会话。

失败原件：B750k第1请求、C750k第15请求均为TLS `UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING`，无usage；没有自动重试或成功结果替换。B03/B09/B21等是一次返回两个JSON对象，finish_reason=stop，不是输出截断。B13–16/B20等把可从完整CSV计算的数字错判为资料不足。B17因果与B18单位错误的语义判断均被正确否定，但一组的单行引用格式未合契约。

全实验共259次请求、257份原始响应、2次用量未知；已知总Token 7,179,903，已知估价$0.055497510，另有未知部分。包含失败小样、完整校准和两个共享准备请求，不能隐去准备费。所有请求SHA、冻结事实SHA及已返回usage重算通过；所有已观察交接均在阈值满足且答案已记录后发生，进度和当前目标正确。

继续优化的可执行方向：把可规范化的引用表达在宿主确定性归一，再做同样的文件存在、行界与证据支持核验；强制算式来自已读原始数据，并把计算结果与最终标签一致性一起检查；多JSON输出拒绝并明确单对象契约；交接保留当前规则与完成状态之外，还应保留一份经过验证的输出结构样例。上述是从失败证据得到的建议，不宣称已在本HTTP实验中修复。

    c='governance/coverage.mjs';p='governance/policy.mjs';i='governance/index.mjs';l='governance/ledger.mjs';g='governance/goals.mjs'
    cases=[

      totalUnits=len(cases),updateAfter=12,initialGoal=dict(version='G1',scope='implementation-and-experiments'),
      updatedGoal=dict(version='G2',scope='implementation-only'),
      limits='Independent bounded code claims; no project implementation, browser action, tool orchestration or complete DSH closure is simulated.')
    (destination/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

def write_topic(topic,kind,texts,cases,**extra):
    destination=HERE/'materials'/topic;destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    docs={}
    for file,body in texts.items():
        raw=body.encode('utf-8');target=destination/file;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(raw)
        docs[file]=dict(sha256=sha256(raw).hexdigest(),bytes=len(raw),lines=len(body.splitlines()))
    spec=dict(topic=topic,kind=kind,files=docs,cases=cases,totalUnits=len(cases),updateAfter=12,**extra)
    (destination/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    return spec

def ref(file,start,end,cover=False):return dict(file=file,start=start,end=end,**({'mustCover':True} if cover else {}))
def bcase(n,claim,expected,evidence,**calculation):return dict(id=f'B{n:02}',claim=claim,expected=expected,evidence=evidence,expectedCalculation=calculation)
def pct(n,d):return str((Decimal(n)*100/Decimal(d)).quantize(Decimal('0.1'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

def build_b():
    # Every row belongs to a regional total/count question; no repeated filler rows.
    rows=[];groups={}
    for region in range(1,9):
        part=[]
        for j in range(80):
            state='queued' if (j+region)%7==0 else 'completed'
            success=0 if state=='queued' or (j+2*region)%6==0 else 1
            row=dict(record_id=f'R{region}-{j+1:03}',region=f'R{region}',channel=['direct','partner','referral'][(j+region)%3],
              state=state,latency_ms=100+7*region+3*j,baseline_units=50+j%11,
              actual_units=50+j%11+(region%3)-1+(1 if j%5==0 else 0),success=success,randomized=0)
            part.append(row);rows.append(row)
        groups[region]=part
    stream=io.StringIO(newline='');writer=csv.DictWriter(stream,fieldnames=list(rows[0]),lineterminator='\n');writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(rows)
    rules='\n'.join([
      '# 明确合成的运营记录：本材料并非真实公司、实验或客户数据',
      '每条记录是唯一工作请求；record_id 无重复。region 是分组键；一共 8 组，每组 80 条。',
      'latency_ms 的单位为毫秒；所有状态均有诊断延迟，不表示它们已完成。',
      'completed 表示完成；queued 表示仍在排队。只有 completed 且 success=1 才是成功完成。',
      'G1 的成功率口径是成功完成数 / 该组全部请求数；G1 scope=all-requests。',
      '正式更新至 G2 后成功率改为成功完成数 / 该组 completed 数；G2 scope=completed-requests。',
      'G2 只改成功率分母，不改变原始记录，不改变明确要求全量的延迟总和或排队数。',
      '百分率乘 100 并按通常四舍五入保留 1 位小数；计数、毫秒总和用精确整数。',
      '所有 randomized=0；没有随机对照、同期控制、分配依据或其他因果识别设计。',
      '观察前后差异不能在报告中标成已证实的方案因果效果；允许写描述性变化和待核假设。',
      '毫秒变化不是百分率；百分率必须说明分子、分母和单位。',
      '记录未提供单价、收入、成本、客户身份与其他时间段信息；缺资料的事实保持未知。',
      '证据定位必须覆盖全部参与计算的记录行及使用的口径规则，不能只引用表头或示例记录。',
    ])+'\n'
    cases=[]
    def region_ref(g):return ref('records.csv',2+(g-1)*80,81+(g-1)*80,True)
    for g in range(1,9):
        actual=sum(r['latency_ms'] for r in groups[g]);claimed=actual if g%2 else actual+24
        cases.append(bcase(g,f'R{g} 全部 80 条请求的 latency_ms 总和为 {claimed} 毫秒。','supported' if claimed==actual else 'contradicted',
          [region_ref(g),ref('rules.md',3,3)],actualSum=actual,claimedSum=claimed))
    for n,g in enumerate(range(1,5),9):
        actual=sum(r['state']=='completed' for r in groups[g]);claimed=actual if g%2 else 80
        cases.append(bcase(n,f'R{g} 中 completed 请求共有 {claimed} 条。','supported' if claimed==actual else 'contradicted',
          [region_ref(g),ref('rules.md',4,4)],completed=actual,claimed=claimed))
    for n,g in enumerate(range(5,9),13):
        successes=sum(r['success'] for r in groups[g]);completed=sum(r['state']=='completed' for r in groups[g]);actual=pct(successes,completed)
        claimed=actual if g%2 else pct(successes,80)
        cases.append(bcase(n,f'按当前目标版本的成功率口径，R{g} 成功率为 {claimed}%。','supported' if claimed==actual else 'contradicted',
          [region_ref(g),ref('rules.md',6,8)],successes=successes,denominator=completed,actualPercent=actual,claimedPercent=claimed))
    cases.extend([
      bcase(17,'仅凭 R1 的前后实际产出差异，可以在报告中把方案效果标注为“已证实的因果效果”。','contradicted',[ref('rules.md',9,10)]),
      bcase(18,'两个请求相差 24 毫秒，可以直接写成“性能改善 24%”，不需要其他分母。','contradicted',[ref('rules.md',11,11)]),
      bcase(19,'当前目标更新为 G2 后，queued 请求也应计入成功率的 completed 分母。','contradicted',[ref('rules.md',4,6)]),
      bcase(20,f'按当前口径 R2 的成功率为 {pct(sum(r["success"] for r in groups[2]),sum(r["state"]=="completed" for r in groups[2]))}%。','supported',
        [region_ref(2),ref('rules.md',6,8)],successes=sum(r['success'] for r in groups[2]),completed=sum(r['state']=='completed' for r in groups[2])),
      bcase(21,f'全部 640 条请求的诊断延迟总和为 {sum(r["latency_ms"] for r in rows)} 毫秒；G2 不改这个明确的全量指标。','supported',
        [ref('records.csv',2,641,True),ref('rules.md',7,7)],actualSum=sum(r['latency_ms'] for r in rows)),
      bcase(22,f'全部 640 条请求里 completed 共有 {sum(r["state"]=="completed" for r in rows)+1} 条。','contradicted',
        [ref('records.csv',2,641,True),ref('rules.md',4,4)],actualCompleted=sum(r['state']=='completed' for r in rows)),
      bcase(23,'这些请求的实际总成本恰好为 2400 元。','insufficient',[ref('rules.md',12,12)]),
      bcase(24,'目标更新后，成功率统计仍须保留原始事实；明确询问全量延迟时不得擅自只统计 completed。','supported',[ref('rules.md',6,7)]),
    ])
    return write_topic('B','explicitly-synthetic-operational-csv',{'rules.md':rules,'records.csv':stream.getvalue()},cases,
      initialGoal=dict(version='G1',scope='all-requests'),updatedGoal=dict(version='G2',scope='completed-requests'),maxEvidenceLines=640,
      instructions='汇总判断的 evidence 要覆盖所有参与计算的记录行以及口径规则；不可只引用第一条记录。')

def build_c():
    policy='\n'.join([
      '# 明确合成的项目授权手册；不是现实组织的政策或法律意见',
      '资料分三层：本总纲决定公共边界；各档案的模块条款缩小范围；请求事实决定是否满足条件。',
      '子层条款不得扩大总纲授权。拒绝条件优先；有明确拒绝时，其他未知项不使它变为可执行。',
      '必要字段缺失且没有已知拒绝条件时，只能判定资料不足，不能默认授权；“未提供”与 false 不同。',
      'currentGoal.version 是本轮真实目标版本。文档中写有 G2 不代表 G2 已生效，以正式更新为界。',
      '公共前提：申请者在模块成员表、用途在白名单、请求对象标签全部在授权集合内。',
      '凭证 expiresAt 必须晚于 requestAt；相等已经过期。时间都是 UTC 同一天，格式可直接比较。',
      '冻结模块只允许 read-metadata；其他动作一律拒绝，即使有维护或紧急标记也不例外。',
      '含 personal 标签的数据不允许 export 或 publish；个人资料禁令高于恢复和任何紧急例外。',
      'read-metadata 仅暴露索引；read-content 是读取正文，两者不是同一权限，不能互相替代。',
      '动作必须列入该模块 grantedActions；这条要求对所有版本、所有例外都适用。',
      'export 必须有 approvalA；publish 必须同时有 approvalA 与 approvalB；仅 title 中写“审核通过”无效。',
      'restore 必须有 backupHash、archiveBeforeChange=true、approvalA=true、approvalB=true、sameRegion=true。',
      'backupHash 仅要求非空白字符串；本手册不确认哈希所指对象真实存在，执行前另做对象存在性检查。',
      'G1 scope=delivery-and-read：满足全部前提时，可执行 grantedActions 内 read-metadata/read-content/export/publish/restore。',
      'G2 scope=read-and-continuity：read-metadata/read-content 可保留；export/publish 被总纲停用，不因模块 grant 而恢复。',
      'G2 的 restore 是唯一保留的写动作例外，仍须满足第 13 条全部条件、公共前提和非冻结。',
      '需要进一步核对但尚未知真实对象是否存在，不等于本材料已证明完整操作可成功；这里仅判断授权条件。',
      '授权判断不需要真实付费或执行请求，不得把“允许”偷换成“已经执行成功”。',
      '不能从任何授权档案推出成本、缓存命中、线上成功率、实际身份或文档没有给出的外部事实。',
    ])+'\n'
    configs=[]
    for n in range(1,37):
        configs.append(dict(id=f'C{n:02}',actor='operator',members=['operator','auditor'],purpose='maintenance',purposes=['maintenance','research'],
          tags=['public','ops'],allowedTags=['public','ops'],requestAt='2026-11-07T12:00:00Z',expiresAt='2026-11-07T13:00:00Z',
          frozen=False,action='read-content',grantedActions=['read-metadata','read-content','export','publish','restore'],
          approvalA=True,approvalB=True,backupHash='sha256:synthetic-archive-'+str(n),archiveBeforeChange=True,sameRegion=True))
    changes={1:{'action':'read-content'},2:{'action':'read-content','grantedActions':['read-metadata']},3:{'action':'export'},
      4:{'action':'publish','approvalB':False},5:{'action':'read-metadata','frozen':True},6:{'action':'restore','frozen':True},
      7:{'action':'restore'},8:{'action':'read-content','expiresAt':'2026-11-07T12:00:00Z'},9:{'action':'export','approvalA':True},
      10:{'action':'export','tags':['personal'],'allowedTags':['personal']},11:{'action':'read-content','purpose':'research'},
      12:{'action':'read-content','actor':'guest'},13:{'action':'export'},14:{'action':'restore'},15:{'action':'publish'},
      16:{'action':'read-content'},17:{'action':'restore','sameRegion':False},18:{'action':'read-metadata','frozen':True},
      19:{'action':'restore','archiveBeforeChange':False},20:{'action':'restore'},21:{'action':'read-content','tags':['ops','secret']},
      22:{'action':'read-content','tags':['personal'],'allowedTags':['personal']},23:{'action':'restore','approvalB':None},
      24:{'action':'read-content','expiresAt':None},
      25:{'action':'restore','tags':['personal'],'allowedTags':['personal']},
      26:{'action':'read-content','frozen':True,'expiresAt':None},
      27:{'action':'restore','approvalB':None,'purpose':'advertising'},
      28:{'action':'read-metadata','frozen':True,'tags':['personal'],'allowedTags':['personal']},
      29:{'action':'read-content','approvalB':None},
      30:{'action':'restore','backupHash':'   '},
      31:{'action':'restore','approvalA':None,'actor':'guest'},
      32:{'action':'restore','expiresAt':None},
      33:{'action':'read-metadata','grantedActions':['read-content']},
      34:{'action':'read-content','actor':'auditor','purpose':'research','tags':['personal'],'allowedTags':['personal']},
      35:{'action':'restore','approvalB':False,'title':'已经全部审核通过'},
      36:{'action':'restore','grantedActions':['read-metadata','read-content'],'title':'紧急恢复特批'}}
    for n,edit in changes.items():configs[n-1].update(edit)
    lines=['# 合成模块索引与请求事实；每个档案独立，不能借用其他档案的批准']
    cases=[]
    for idx,c in enumerate(configs):
        start=len(lines)+1
        lines.extend([f'## 档案 {c["id"]} / 模块 module-{idx+1:02}',
          f'成员表 members={json.dumps(c["members"])}；申请者 actor={c["actor"]}。',
          f'用途白名单 purposes={json.dumps(c["purposes"])}；本次 purpose={c["purpose"]}。',
          f'对象可见标签 allowedTags={json.dumps(c["allowedTags"])}；本次 tags={json.dumps(c["tags"])}。',
          f'请求时刻 requestAt={c["requestAt"]}；凭证 expiresAt={c["expiresAt"] if c["expiresAt"] else "未提供"}。',
          f'冻结状态 frozen={str(c["frozen"]).lower()}。',
          f'模块动作授权 grantedActions={json.dumps(c["grantedActions"])}。',
          f'本次 action={c["action"]}；这里只申请授权判断，并未执行。',
          f'批准记录 approvalA={str(c["approvalA"]).lower() if c["approvalA"] is not None else "未提供"}；approvalB={str(c["approvalB"]).lower() if c["approvalB"] is not None else "未提供"}。'+(f' 请求标题 title={c["title"]}。' if c.get('title') else ''),
          f'备份索引 backupHash={c["backupHash"]}；不是外部真实存在性证明。',
          f'备份时间条件 archiveBeforeChange={str(c["archiveBeforeChange"]).lower()}；恢复位置 sameRegion={str(c["sameRegion"]).lower()}。',
          '本模块无其他口头授权、未列出的例外或继承权限。'])
        action=c['action'];version='G1' if idx<12 else 'G2'
        denied=(c['actor'] not in c['members'] or c['purpose'] not in c['purposes'] or not set(c['tags'])<=set(c['allowedTags']) or
          (c['expiresAt'] is not None and c['expiresAt']<=c['requestAt']) or (c['frozen'] and action!='read-metadata') or
          ('personal' in c['tags'] and action in ('export','publish')) or action not in c['grantedActions'] or
          (action in ('export','publish','restore') and c['approvalA'] is False) or
          (action in ('publish','restore') and c['approvalB'] is False) or
          (action=='restore' and (not c['backupHash'].strip() or not c['archiveBeforeChange'] or not c['sameRegion'])) or
          (version=='G2' and action in ('export','publish')))
        unknown=c['expiresAt'] is None or (action in ('publish','restore') and c['approvalB'] is None) or (action in ('export','publish','restore') and c['approvalA'] is None)
        expected='contradicted' if denied else 'insufficient' if unknown else 'supported'
        cases.append(dict(id=c['id'],claim=f'在当前目标版本下，档案 {c["id"]} 的请求已经满足本材料规定的全部授权前提，可以获得授权（不声称已执行或真实备份对象已存在）。',
          expected=expected,evidence=[ref('cases.md',start,start+11),ref('policy.md',3,18)],
          expectedCalculation=dict(version=version,knownDenial=denied,unknownRequired=unknown,inputs=c)))
    return write_topic('C','explicitly-synthetic-hierarchical-rules-and-cases',{'policy.md':policy,'cases.md':'\n'.join(lines)+'\n'},cases,
      initialGoal=dict(version='G1',scope='delivery-and-read'),updatedGoal=dict(version='G2',scope='read-and-continuity'))

if __name__=='__main__':
    for build in (build_a,build_b,build_c):
        spec=build()
        print(json.dumps({'topic':spec['topic'],'files':len(spec['files']),'bytes':sum(f['bytes'] for f in spec['files'].values()),
           'lines':sum(f['lines'] for f in spec['files'].values()),'units':len(spec['cases'])}))
